CA.rationale: Content (red position) and a processing-origin (command_estimate) are explicitly bound to the same candidate referent/time.

COD.rationale: Identified content (red) plus explicit organization/metadata (origin) are both present for the same referent/time, demonstrating separate content vs organization/status.

A.rationale: Processing-origin fields (e.g. command_estimate, history_estimate) are explicitly tied to particular content referents, linking process/attention-like conditions to content organization/access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content identifications list color-labeled positions (red/blue) tied to named referents and times.

D.rationale: Content entries (red) are recorded separately from organization/status metadata (origin) for the same referent/time, demonstrating content/status differentiation.

O.rationale: Explicit organization/presentation metadata (origin, represented_time, inherited_current) describe how contents are represented/presented/accessed.
